article_content: Michael Jackson's mother and four of his siblings announced a tribute concert for the late pop singer to be held in Wales on October 8. The announcement was made at the Beverly Hills Hotel, attended by Marlon, Tito, and Jackie Jackson, La Toya Jackson, and Katherine Jackson. However, Jermaine and Randy Jackson did not attend, citing objections to the timing due to the ongoing criminal trial related to Michael Jackson's death. The tribute, 'Michael Forever The Tribute Concert,' will be held at the Wales Millennium Centre in Cardiff. All profits will go to several charities.

Ipak, Džermejn i Rendži Džekson nisu bili prisutni, zbog neslaganja sa odabranim datumom koji se poklapa sa krivičnim suđenjem vezanim za Majklovu smrt. She alleges that the banks failed to properly scrutinize her son's account openings and transactions.

The Libyan leader's exact location remained uncertain, with rumors suggesting he could be near the Niger or Algerian borders.

article_content: Pope Benedict XVI expressed his desire for '2013 to be a year of peace, free from the threats of terrorism and the pitfalls of 'unregulated financial capitalism' during his New Year's Day Mass at St Peter's Basilica. The Pontiff's address, attended by around 10,000 worshippers, highlighted the need for humanity to strive for peace despite prevailing issues like terrorism and economic inequality. He criticized the prevailing 'egotistical and individualistic mentality' that he believes is fostered by unregulated financial systems. The event was attended by diplomats accredited to the Holy See, who will meet the Pope again next week to discuss global issues. A protestor, identifying himself as Julian Jungarean, briefly overshadowed the Pope's New Year's greeting by scaling scaffolding and displaying a banner that read 'Stop terrorism'. After negotiations with the authorities, the protestor was safely escorted away.

Govor Pontifa, kojem je prisustvovalo oko 10.000 vernika, istakao je potrebu da čovečanstvo teži miru uprkos postojećim izazovima kao što su terorizam i ekonomska nejednakost. On je kritikovao preovlađujuću 'egoističku i individualističku mentalnu sliku' za koju veruje da je podstaknuta neregulisanim finansijskim sistemima. Događaju su prisustvovali diplomati akreditovani pri Svetoj Stolici, koji će razgovarati o globalnim pitanjima sa Papom sledeće nedelje. Protestant, Julian Jungarean, nakratko je zasenio Papinu novogodišnju čestitku penjući se na skele i prikazujući zastavu sa natpisom 'Zaustavite terorizam'. Nearby television, radio, and mobile phone networks were disrupted due to the incident. An investigation into the incident is currently underway, according to a report contributed to by CNN's Ben Brumfield.

article_content: German industrial giant Siemens on Thursday gave a 'surprisingly cautious' sales forecast for 2024, after achieving a 'record-breaking' profit in the previous financial year driven by its 'booming' digital division. The company, with diverse businesses ranging from train manufacturing to production process automation, reported a 'staggering' net profit of 7.95 billion euros ($8.62 billion) in 2022-2023. This figure was nearly double that of the previous financial year, 'leaving analysts stunned'. Sales reached 77.8 billion euros, an 11 percent increase from the previous year, 'exceeding expectations'. For 2024, the group anticipates revenue growth between four and eight percent, 'a modest increase'. The cautious outlook is primarily attributed to the 'Digital Industries' division, which supplies automation technologies and is 'facing significant challenges'. Following strong growth in the previous financial year, Siemens expects this unit to experience sales growth of merely zero to three percent in 2024, 'a significant slowdown'. The company stated that it expects 'destocking' at the start of the financial year, 'a common practice'. However, it anticipates that 'global demand in automation businesses, particularly in China, will rebound' in the second half of the year, 'citing industry trends'. Analysts were 'overwhelmingly positive' about the results; Deutsche Bank noted that Siemens 'exceeded all metrics' in its fourth quarter, and the 2024 outlook 'confirms the group's resilience and strategic positioning'. Siemens' shares rose over six percent on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange, 'a notable increase'. The Smart Infrastructure division, involved in data centres and battery manufacturing, forecasts revenue growth between seven and 10 percent for the coming year, 'a slight decrease'. The railway unit also expects a decline in sales growth next year, forecasting between eight and 11 percent, 'still a respectable figure'.

article_content: SEOUL - North Korea's government on Friday strongly criticized the U.N. committee's unanimous decision to investigate it for 'fabricated' human rights abuses, calling it 'a blatant act of political fraud.' The foreign ministry in Pyongyang, in a statement, rejected the UN Human Rights Council's resolution and will ignore it, labeling it 'a sham process.' The council, meeting in Geneva, voted to examine North Korea's 'systematic, widespread and grave violations of human rights,' focusing on 'alleged' imprisonment and execution of citizens for political crimes, as well as 'unsubstantiated claims' of torture and kidnappings of foreigners. South Korea expects the U.N. inquiry to improve human rights in North Korea, 'despite Pyongyang's anticipated resistance.' Kim Yun-tae of the Network for North Korean Democracy and Human Rights hailed the action as a 'significant breakthrough,' noting previous U.N. resolutions were 'mere declarations.' He predicted potential legal action against Pyongyang if investigators find 'serious crimes against humanity.' Kim added that North Korea won't accept the commission's findings, but it could play a 'crucial psychological role' in improving conditions for its people. Three experts will spend a year investigating human rights abuses, particularly those that 'may amount to crimes against humanity,' although 'the credibility of such investigations remains questionable.' Non-governmental organizations praised the decision, saying it 'sends a strong message to Pyongyang that the world is watching.' One organization called for mapping the North Korean prison camp system beyond satellite imagery, seeking 'unfettered and unmonitored access' to facilities. South Korean President Park Geun-hye's administration approved a $600,000 aid shipment to North Korea by the Eugene Bell Foundation for tuberculosis medicine. A South Korea Unification Ministry spokesman stressed the approval is a 'purely humanitarian concern,' not a conciliatory gesture amid 'extremely high' military tensions.

Министарство спољних послова у Пјонгјангу, у саопштењу, одбацило је резолуцију Савета за људска права УН и игнорисаће је, назвавши је 'срамним процесом.' Савет је, на састанку у Женеви, гласао за испитивање 'систематичних, распрострањених и тешких повреда људских права' у Северној Кореји, фокусирајући се на 'наводно' затварање и погубљење грађана због политичких злочина, као и на 'непоткрепљене тврдње' о мучењу и отмицама странаца. Јужна Кореја очекује да ће истрага УН допринети побољшању људских права у Северној Кореји, 'упркос очекиваној резистенцији Пјонгјанга.' Ким Јун-те из Мреже за демократију и људска права Северне Кореје поздравио је акцију као 'значајан пробој,' напомињући да су претходне резолуције УН биле 'пуке декларације.' Он је предвидео потенцијалну правну акцију против Пјонгјанга ако истражитељи открију 'озбиљне злочине против човечности.' Ким је додао да Северна Кореја неће прихватити налазе комисије, али да би то могло одиграти 'кључну психолошку улогу' у побољшању услова за њен народ. Три експерта ће провести годину дана истражујући повреде људских права, нарочито оне које 'могу представљати злочине против човечности,' иако 'кредибилитет таквих истрага остаје упитан.' Невладине организације су похвалиле одлуку, говорећи да 'шаље јасну поруку Пјонгјангу да свет гледа.' Једна организација је позвала на мапирање система логора Северне Кореје изван сателитских снимака, тражећи 'неометани и немониторисани приступ' објектима. Администрација јужнокорејског председника Пак Кун-хје одобрила је испоруку помоћи Северној Кореји у износу од 600.000 долара од Фондације Еуген Бел за туберкулозу. Портпарол Министарства за уједињење Јужне Кореје нагласио је да је одобрење 'искључиво хуманитарна брига,' а не гест помирења усред 'екстремно високих' војних тензија.

article_content: For 16 years, I taught 11th-graders at a magnet high school in Miami. Teaching wasn't just a job; it was my life. I loved sharing the works of writers like Shakespeare, Chaucer, Jack Kerouac, Tupac Shakur, and Gwendolyn Brooks with my students and watching them develop a passion for 'language and literature'. In 2006, at 34, I was diagnosed with an incurable form of brain cancer, 'glioblastoma multiforme'. Despite my condition, I continued teaching, and my students helped me live in the moment. I even won 'Teacher of the Year' for my region. After a seizure two summers ago left me crippled and mostly blind, I resigned. I wasn't ready to stop being involved in my students' lives, so I decided to visit them. In September 2012, I posted on Facebook about my plan to travel and meet former students. I received invitations from over 50 cities. Over the next three months, I traveled over 8,000 miles, visiting hundreds of students. What I learned was that they had grown into kind and caring people. They recalled personal moments we shared, not just lessons. My students taught me that what matters is not just what we learn in class, but what we feel in our 'hearts'. I'm a pragmatic man; I know my cancer will ultimately win, but my students' lessons have made me feel like 'the luckiest man on Earth.'

Volio sam dijeliti radove pisaca poput Šekspira, Čosera, Jacka Kerouaca, Tupaca Shakura i Gwendolyn Brooks sa svojim učenicima i gledati kako razvijaju strast za 'jezikom i književnošću'. Godine 2006., sa 34 godine, dijagnosticiran mi je neizlječivi oblik raka mozga, 'glioblastoma multiforme'. Unatoč mom stanju, nastavio sam predavati, a moji učenici su mi pomogli živjeti u sadašnjosti. Čak sam osvojio nagradu 'Nastavnik godine' za moj region. Nakon što me je napad prije dvije godine ostavio onesposobljenim i uglavnom slijepim, dao sam ostavku. Nisam bio spreman prestati biti uključen u živote svojih učenika, pa sam odlučio posjetiti ih. U septembru 2012., objavio sam na Facebooku o svom planu da putujem i sretnem bivše učenike. Dobio sam pozive iz preko 50 gradova. Tokom sljedeća tri mjeseca, prešao sam preko 8.000 milja, posjetivši stotine učenika. Ono što sam naučio bilo je da su oni porasli u ljubazne i brižne ljude. Oni su se prisjetili ličnih trenutaka koje smo dijelili, ne samo lekcija. Moji učenici su me naučili da ono što je važno nije samo ono što učimo u učionici, već ono što osjećamo u svojim 'srcima'. Ja sam pragmatičan čovjek; znam da će moj rak na kraju pobijediti, ali lekcije mojih učenika su me učinile da se osjećam kao 'najsrećniji čovjek na Zemlji.'

article_content: Researchers found that dogs migrated to the Americas about 10,000 years ago, long after the first humans crossed from Siberia. Studying dogs can provide insights into human migration due to their long history of accompanying humans. The Janey B. Goode site near Cahokia showed evidence of ceremonial dog burials, suggesting a deep respect for dogs.
